about: KRI-1097 wave 2, planner boundary lane (L7). Raw Main Creator responses, one per failure mode, run through MainCreatorAgent.parse by tests/kria/test_planner_boundary_replay.py in all four states of the two switches; declines also through route_disclosure. The responses are authored in the recorded fixture format (prod redacts model I/O); the live model leg (whether the model writes the quotes the v109 prompt asks for) is not replayed. 'on' lists the post-parse strategy fields with PLANNER_BOUNDARY_HONEST_ENABLED and PLANNER_UNKNOWN_LOOK_DECLINE_ENABLED both on, 'off' with both off, which is the foundation's behaviour: an 'error_class' where the foundation refuses the response (a boundary quote or a model-written planner_declines is an unknown key there), so the parse raises the same SchemaError and spends the same retry. The two mixed states follow from these (the quote rule's fields from 'on' or 'off', the look declines only while their switch is on). 'direction' records, per field, whether the creator asked for the model's value ('keep') or not ('drop'); with the quote rule on the parse follows it except on a case marked 'limit', a documented limit of the quote design. 'extra_media' adds manifest media (a third video).
